statement: Frozen before any model run on crm-nl-relations. Ground truth (`expected`) was written from the scenario's documented business meaning (a Dutch CRM; 'bedrijf' = company, 'contactpersoon' = contact person, 'sinds' = customer-since date, day-first) before any Nano or Gemini output on this scenario existed. The holdout is never profiled, disclosed, used for feedback or used to change a prompt.

configurations.A: Deterministic profiling only (no model). Roles and date order from the deterministic profile. Computed offline.
configurations.B: A + real Gemini Nano (ONLY_ON_DEVICE) reading bounded private context; only validated suggestions, applied by the user, change the twin.
configurations.C: Real Gemini Cloud initial mapping from the deterministic twin (harness check S8-B). No Nano, no revision.
configurations.D: Real Gemini Cloud initial mapping from the twin with B's applied suggestions (harness check S8-CD with EYES_LIVE_NO_REVISION=1). No revision.

comparisons.downstream: D vs C, paired by trial

hypotheses.H1: A (deterministic) cannot establish the meaning of 'bedrijf' and 'contactpersoon' (generic role) nor the day/month order of 'sinds' (unproven).
hypotheses.H2: B: Nano yields at least one validated, applicable suggestion that matches the ground-truth semantics of 'bedrijf', 'contactpersoon' or 'sinds' in at least 2 of 3 trials, with no applicable suggestion that contradicts the ground truth.
hypotheses.H3: D beats C on holdout correct transformations (paired by trial) in at least 2 of the valid pairs, with no pair where D is worse.
hypotheses.outcomes: Positive (H2 and H3 hold), neutral (H2 holds, H3 does not), negative (Nano adds wrong applicable suggestions, or D is worse than C). All three are reportable.

budget.model: gemini-3.5-flash-lite (Firebase AI Logic, ONLY_IN_CLOUD) and Gemini Nano (ONLY_ON_DEVICE)
budget.retries: none: a provider failure is recorded as a failure and is not repeated or replaced
budget.stopRule: Stop when trials 1–3 are complete or 6 cloud requests were sent, whichever comes first. No trial is discarded.
budget.authorization: Each request goes through the in-app approval gate; the live spec approves exactly what it previews.
budget.environment: Local dev server with the registered App Check debug token and the dedicated Nano Chrome profile.

metrics: Nano suggestions: consistent / applicable / rejected; applied; matches ground-truth semantics
Initial mapping differs between C and D
Holdout and feedback-set correct transformations, incorrect, quarantined (replayed by src/evaluation/aggregate.ts)
Field-level holdout errors: organization/contactName swapped, customerSince day/month swapped
Cloud request count, human interventions, private terms in request bodies, model/provider failures
